bio: Located in the city centre, in an old townhouse accessible via a small courtyard, this restaurant is owned by Jan-Hendrik Feldner, who also runs the nearby ESTIMA by Catalana. As a connoisseur of Spanish cuisine, the chef proposes a down-to-earth tapas concept in his convivial, simple little establishment. The menu features authentically prepared small dishes mainly inspired by Catalan cuisine – it's best to order four or five. The chef also serves and talks you through the dishes....
